scenario.label: GBE Precision Reach
scenario.freeform_prompt: Concentrate spend on the most precisely targetable GBE inventory: financial publisher PMPs, contextual energy and markets targeting, and job-title-proxy social audiences.
scenario.scenario_assumption: GBE Precision Reach prioritises audience quality over scale, so cost per engagement rises as spend moves into premium PMP inventory.

response_curve.mmm_anchor: Historical bp CTV bursts show strong completed-view and GBE reach gains at current spend, flattening once the premium GBE-skewed inventory pool is fully reached.
response_curve.external_shape_prior: Premium CTV saturates on available GBE-skewed inventory rather than budget; carryover is moderate, consistent with video brand-response literature.
response_curve.adstock_half_life_weeks: 2 to 4, moderate carryover - recall persists across a results window
response_curve.conflict_note: Campaign history and external CTV evidence agree CTV is the reach backbone for GBE, capped by premium inventory supply.

response_curve.mmm_anchor: PMP inventory on financial publishers scales close to linearly until preferred deals are fully used, after which open-exchange fill dilutes GBE quality.
response_curve.external_shape_prior: Display saturates slowly on impressions but quality falls when spend spills from PMPs into open exchange; response is largely same-period.
response_curve.adstock_half_life_weeks: 0 to 1, minimal carryover - response is largely same-period
response_curve.conflict_note: Campaign history and publisher benchmarks agree display is precise but low-engagement; the cap is PMP supply, not budget.

response_curve.mmm_anchor: bp's limited video history shows good completed-view rates on financial publisher video, with diminishing returns once business-content inventory is covered.
response_curve.external_shape_prior: Online video typically saturates faster than CTV on narrow audiences; modest carryover.
response_curve.adstock_half_life_weeks: 1 to 2, modest carryover
response_curve.conflict_note: Campaign history is thinner than external benchmarks suggest; treat the response curve as a prior to be validated in-flight.

response_curve.mmm_anchor: bp's Meta activity reaches financial-professional proxies cheaply, but GBE-qualified reach saturates quickly once the proxy audience is covered.
response_curve.external_shape_prior: Narrow professional audiences on Meta saturate fast; frequency builds within days of a burst.
response_curve.adstock_half_life_weeks: 0 to 1, minimal carryover
response_curve.conflict_note: Cheap engagement disagrees with uncertain GBE match quality; IPSOS IGI validation is needed before scaling.

monthly_allocations.rationale: CTV & Streaming allocation uses the GBE Precision Reach strategy, the7stars historical performance prior (35% blended share; primary_mmm), the January budget target, timing weight and a cited response-curve prior. the7stars campaign history shows CTV as bp's strongest driver of GBE view-through and completed views, with efficient reach up to roughly £260k a month before frequency builds faster than new GBE reach. Curve: moderate-saturation concave response; Campaign history and external CTV evidence agree CTV is the reach backbone for GBE, capped by premium inventory supply. Phasing rule: Hold an always-on premium presence; concentrate weight in the two weeks around each results announcement, the AGM and the strategy update rather than spreading evenly. Scenario assumption: GBE Precision Reach prioritises audience quality over scale, so cost per engagement rises as spend moves into premium PMP inventory.

monthly_allocations.rationale: Programmatic Display allocation uses the GBE Precision Reach strategy, the7stars historical performance prior (25% blended share; primary_mmm), the January budget target, timing weight and a cited response-curve prior. Historical bp display delivery shows financial-publisher PMPs reaching GBE at the highest audience quality in the mix, with viewability well above open-exchange benchmarks but a lower engagement rate than video. Curve: slow-saturation linear-to-concave response; Campaign history and publisher benchmarks agree display is precise but low-engagement; the cap is PMP supply, not budget. Phasing rule: Keep an always-on contextual layer; lift PMP weight in results weeks and around energy conferences when financial-publisher readership peaks. Scenario assumption: GBE Precision Reach prioritises audience quality over scale, so cost per engagement rises as spend moves into premium PMP inventory.

monthly_allocations.rationale: Meta allocation uses the GBE Precision Reach strategy, the7stars historical performance prior (15% blended share; brief_required_gap), the November budget target, timing weight and a cited response-curve prior. Meta is brief-required but GBE targeting relies on interest and professional proxies, so it is treated as a measurement-led amplification layer rather than a proven GBE channel. Curve: quick-saturation concave response; Cheap engagement disagrees with uncertain GBE match quality; IPSOS IGI validation is needed before scaling. Phasing rule: Concentrate around results days, the AGM and major energy conferences; avoid thin always-on spend that drifts outside the GBE audience. Scenario assumption: GBE Precision Reach prioritises audience quality over scale, so cost per engagement rises as spend moves into premium PMP inventory.

response_curve.mmm_anchor: bp's Meta activity reaches financial-professional proxies cheaply, but GBE-qualified reach saturates quickly once the proxy audience is covered.
response_curve.external_shape_prior: Narrow professional audiences on Meta saturate fast; frequency builds within days of a burst.

criteria.label: Hits the brief target frame
criteria.requirement: Generated plan should balance to the supplied 2026 budget and show whether forecast GBE engagements clear 3,400,000 at or below the £1.55 brief cost per engagement.

criteria.label: Uses campaign history where available
criteria.requirement: Channel rationales should cite the7stars BigQuery campaign history and identify any channel where the brief asks for more than the historical evidence supports.

criteria.label: Responds to named brief priorities
criteria.requirement: Plan QA should flag priority areas requiring explicit treatment: results season, AGM and strategy update, energy conferences, GBE precision, channel role clarity and measurement.

criteria.label: Separates evidence gaps from confident recommendations
criteria.requirement: Online Video and Meta should be tagged as measurement-led choices until IPSOS IGI validation confirms GBE match quality.

warnings: Response curves are anchored on the7stars campaign history and externally shaped, but remain confidence-band priors until the BigQuery pipeline refresh is live.
